density.meaning: A prior ingredient-density estimate lacks complete valid ingredient contributions or otherwise fails density eligibility.
density.required_behavior: Density nutrient values and associated traffic-light labels are null; availability and confidence are false. Missing is not zero and must not satisfy an upper-bound nutrition filter.
density.complete_contribution_limit: Arithmetic completeness does not establish ingredient identity, quantity accuracy, cooking yield or compatible raw/cooked source basis.

supplemental_fraction.meaning: Denominator evidence for the fraction of computed ingredient calories attributed to supplemental FCT records.
supplemental_fraction.required_behavior: Unavailable fractions remain null. Numeric zero describes a usable denominator with no supplemental energy only when the basis is verified; legacy zero has an unverified denominator.
supplemental_fraction.limitation: Not a fraction of Indian laboratory data, ingredient mass, all nutrients or independently validated recipe energy.

weight_confidence.numerator: Number of current ingredient occurrence rows whose estimator confident flag is true.
weight_confidence.denominator: Number of current ingredient occurrence rows for that recipe.
weight_confidence.missingness: No occurrence rows means unavailable (null), not zero. Zero means rows exist and none has the flag.
weight_confidence.limitation: Estimator-tier fraction, not calibrated probability, source-quantity accuracy or nutrient accuracy.
